plan.title: fix(hygiene): two lockfile-reader patterns flagged by CodeQL as slow on crafted input

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan group G-K (story id ovpr-g-codeql), decision D-035, issue #6680. CodeQL flags two lazy-group regexes in the pnpm lockfile reader in packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts (`specifier:` and `version:` lines) as slow on crafted input. Replace them with a prefix match plus trim, and add a long-line test.
narratives.Overview:
CodeQL flags two existing patterns in the pnpm lockfile reader, `packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts` lines ~637 and ~642 (`/^ {8}specifier:\s*(.+?)\s*$/` and `/^ {8}version:\s*(.+?)\s*$/`, from #5245). A crafted lockfile line could make them slow (polynomial regex). The input is the project's own lockfile on the local machine, so the risk is low. P2-U0 (#6658, the read-only ownership API, #6615) now reaches this code, which is why CodeQL raised it there.

Fix: match the line prefix without the lazy group and trim the value (for example `line.startsWith("        specifier:")` then `.slice(...).trim()`), with a test for a very long line.

Decided by polfer (D-035): #6658 merged with the warning; this ticket fixes it.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer, I want the pnpm lockfile reader to parse `specifier:` and `version:` lines without polynomial regexes, so that CodeQL is clean and a crafted lockfile line cannot slow the reader down.
narratives.StoryId: ovpr-g-codeql (carried in the file name so the ordered plan can match it; plan.id stays the id minted from the issue, because the brief tools refuse a different plan.id)
narratives.UnitSpec: No unit spec: polfer decision D-035 (DECISIONS.md) and issue #6680 define the fix.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts: replace `/^ {8}specifier:\s*(.+?)\s*$/` and `/^ {8}version:\s*(.+?)\s*$/` with a check for the exact 8-space prefix (`line.startsWith("        specifier:")` / `"        version:"`) and `.slice(prefix.length).trim()`; keep the same results for empty and quoted values.
2. packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.test.ts: add a test that a lockfile line with a very long value (for example 100k spaces between the key and a value) parses quickly and gives the same specifier/version as before.
3. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6680-lockfile-reader-regex.md.
narratives.Constraint:
- Two-line regex fix only; no other behaviour change in the lockfile reader.
- Keep the existing hygiene tests green; do not weaken any assertion.
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Dependencies: Depends on: none (P2-U0 #6658 already merged). Blocks: none.
narratives.PlanningOrder: design-critique: not warranted, because the OVPR fix plan and its unit specs already decide the design (polfer decisions D-001, D-008, D-037)

items.title: The pnpm lockfile reader no longer uses the two lazy-group `specifier:` / `version:` regexes; it matches the 8-space prefix and trims the value.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.ts, when the pnpm lockfile reader parses a `specifier:` or `version:` line, then it uses a prefix match plus trim and the patterns `/^ {8}specifier:\s*(.+?)\s*$/` and `/^ {8}version:\s*(.+?)\s*$/` are gone.

items.title: A lockfile line with a very long value parses quickly and gives the same result as before.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a pnpm lockfile whose `specifier:` or `version:` line has a very long run of whitespace, when the hygiene lockfile reader parses it, then it returns the trimmed value and the test finishes well inside the default timeout.

items.title: Existing lockfile parsing results are unchanged (quoted values, empty values, other indent levels).

narrative.Acceptance: Given the existing hygiene.test.ts lockfile fixtures, when `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/init-deposit/hygiene.test.ts` runs, then all existing cases pass unchanged.
